title: CartoonCraft
description: Make your game look like an animated trailer or a cartoon!
body:
**What it does?**
**This modpack adds:**
- custom settings shaders
- new textures
- animations
- cool atmospherics
- cool effects.

It makes a cool animated vibe and not just looking like a trailer. **_Inspiration of Bedrock Edition's **Actions & Stuff**.
